summary: Phase 9 / B3 Light CMS backend testing completed successfully. All 68 tests passed (100% success rate). Verified generic CRUD for 5 content collections (destinations, packages, articles, testimonials, promos) with proper ID prefixes, field whitelist enforcement, type coercion, RBAC, audit logging, and public endpoint filtering.
passed_tests: Authentication: All 3 users (owner, ops_admin, driver) login successfully
List Content: GET /api/content/{resource} returns correct counts for all 5 resources (destinations=4, packages=2, articles=3, testimonials=3, promos=2)
Create Content: POST /api/content/{resource} with correct ID prefixes (dst_, pkg_, art_, tst_, pro_)
Field Whitelist: Unknown fields (junk_field, unknown_field) properly ignored and not stored
Type Coercion: Int (days, price_from, rating), float (discount_value), bool (popular, active) coerced correctly
Articles: published_at auto-set when missing on creation
Update Content: PUT /api/content/{resource}/{id} updates fields and sets updated_at
Update: Unknown fields ignored in updates, 404 for non-existent IDs
Delete Content: DELETE /api/content/{resource}/{id} returns {ok: true} and removes from list
Delete: 404 for non-existent IDs
Unknown Resource: GET/POST to unknown resource returns 404 with 'Jenis konten tidak dikenal'
Public Endpoints: GET /api/public/packages and /api/public/promos work without auth and return only active items
Public Filtering: Inactive package appears in CMS list but NOT in public endpoint
RBAC: 401 without auth token on all /api/content/* endpoints
RBAC: Driver gets 403 on all GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/content/* operations
RBAC: Owner and ops_admin get 200 on /api/content/* endpoints
Audit Logging: Content create/update/delete operations generate audit log entries with correct action, entity_type, entity_id, and actor_id
Regression: B1 pricing endpoints (GET /api/pricing/rules) still working
Regression: B2 quotations endpoints (GET /api/quotations) still working
Regression: Public endpoints (/api/public/destinations, articles, testimonials) return seeded data

success_percentage.frontend: N/A (frontend testing skipped as per request)
